what_it_is: Flexible aspiration catheter with stainless-steel and coil plus braid reinforcements designed to remove thrombus. Available in APRO 55 and APRO 70 sizes. Includes Alembic aspiration tubing accessory.
sizing_specs: Models: APRO 55, APRO 70; Alembic aspiration tubing: proximal length 100 inch, distal length 7 inch, proximal/distal ID 0.110 inch
indications: Aspiration thrombectomy for removal of thrombus from cerebral vasculature.
compatible_with: Phenom microcatheters, Solitaire X revascularization device, Alembic aspiration tubing
